The way it is packaged right now hinges on `electron` being available: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/a3854adcaf99548d2a7b3bb72710a0b7d100c63f/pkgs/by-name/gi/github-desktop/package.nix#L172

I'll look in a way to package for darwin, but I might need some help with testing from you as I can't really test it (and I have little to no knowledge about packaging for nix-darwin)

> but I might need some help with testing from you as I can't really test it (and I have little to no knowledge about packaging for nix-darwin)

Happy to help @dtomvan !

Little clarification: I tried to add this package via standalone Home Manager, not via `nix-darwin` as such:

```nix
home.packages = [ pkgs.github-desktop ];
```

I also guess it's possible to either build by following the [official instructions](https://github.com/desktop/desktop/blob/development/docs/contributing/setup-macos.md) or by just downloading a binary from the release artefacts (seems ok on non-Linux platforms)

I overrode `electron-packager` to output a darwin package while on linux and it happily obliged (outside of a nix build, to test out what gets output):

```ShellSession
$ erd dist -L 2
     4096 B    ┌─ LICENSE
     4096 B    ├─ version
 15704064 B    ├─ LICENSES.chromium.html
516440064 B    ├─ desktop.app
532152320 B ┌─ desktop-darwin-x64
532152320 B dist
```

So I tried this (since it seems like one can just copy the appdir into `$out/Applications` for macos): https://github.com/dtomvan/nixpkgs/commit/6870742095fbaf5fba7a4aadf75ae92642e7f0d0

At least evals on my machine with:

```ShellSession
$ nix-build --expr 'with import ./. { system = "aarch64-darwin"; }; github-desktop'
these 2 derivations will be built:
  /nix/store/mbsaxj2wkmadhqlz19wfkwkj9r9bi48p-github-desktop.desktop.drv
  /nix/store/459kbci7lin9pz1vxmkanskgc80mzws1-github-desktop-3.5.8.drv
[...]
error: Cannot build '/nix/store/mbsaxj2wkmadhqlz19wfkwkj9r9bi48p-github-desktop.desktop.drv'.
       Reason: platform mismatch
       Required system: 'aarch64-darwin'
       Current system: 'x86_64-linux'
```

So I think that's ready for you to test. I hope it works 🤞🏼 

Could you try to build this with:

```ShellSession
$ nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' build -L --keep-failed github:dtomvan/nixpkgs/6870742095fbaf5fba7a4aadf75ae92642e7f0d0#github-desktop
(or git checkout 6870742095fbaf5fba7a4aadf75ae92642e7f0d0 if you happen to have nixpkgs cloned)
$ ./result/bin/github-desktop
```

- Unstable (26.05)

### Describe the bug

[Marked supported on Darwin at search.nixos.org](https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=unstable&include_modular_service_options=1&include_nixos_options=1&query=github-desktop&show=github-desktop)

But in practice, the build fails on `aarch64-darwin`

`meta.platforms` is inherited from `pkgs.electron`: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/a3854adcaf99548d2a7b3bb72710a0b7d100c63f/pkgs/by-name/gi/github-desktop/package.nix#L205

However, electron [seems to be Linux only]:https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/b44e340c49abc9184a9f4b4dbe65c8d4a76a3937/pkgs/development/tools/electron/common.nix#L314

### Steps to reproduce

Run `nix-build -A github-desktop --show-trace` at `nixpgs/master` and compare the result with NixOS Search info.

a) Should be available on Darwin because the upstream app is supported
b) NixOS Search should reflect the actual scope of supported platforms to avoid confusion
